entries.title: Psalms 1:1
segments: ¶Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the wicked, and standeth not in the way of sinners, and sitteth not in the seat of scorners;

entries.title: Psalms 1:2
segments: But his delight is in Jehovah's law, and in his law doth he meditate day and night.

entries.title: Psalms 1:3
segments: And he [is] as a tree planted by brooks of water, which giveth its fruit in its season, and whose leaf fadeth not; and all that he doeth prospereth.

entries.title: Psalms 1:4
segments: ¶The wicked are not so; but are as the chaff which the wind driveth away.

entries.title: Psalms 1:5
segments: Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the assembly of the righteous.

entries.title: Psalms 1:6
segments: For Jehovah knoweth the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked shall perish.
